title: SRS Stored Container Entry
description: RFC-051 [R1]. One entry of a stored Container, at containers/<containerId>/entries/<instanceId>.json, written on one line (RFC-051 [R3]). The logical memberInstanceIds outline is decoded from a container's entries (RFC-051 [R5]); this file is storage only and is never presented by an adapter.

containerId.description: RFC-051 [R1]-[R2]. The container this entry belongs to; MUST equal the directory's containerId (container-entry-misplaced).

instanceId.description: RFC-051 [R1]-[R2]. The member; MUST equal the file name (container-name-mismatch) and resolve against the instance set (RFC-051 [R12]).

parent.description: RFC-051 [R5]. The instanceId of this entry's parent entry in the same container; absent means top level. A parent naming no entry is an orphan, and a parent chain that loops is a loop (RFC-051 [R6], warnings).

key.description: RFC-051 [R4] and Appendix. The fractional-index position among siblings, compared byte-wise. The integer-part length, the reserved key and the no-trailing-0 fraction rule are validator checks (arrangement-key).
